decision: Freeze the exact inherited complexity failures without changing the historical baseline. Permit no new failure or growth. Reduce matchesReferralFilters during the approved referral-store slice and separately own the other ten functions.

ownerApproval.directive: Replace TARS’s mandatory independent-review and guidance-evaluation start gates with an owner-authorized fast lane. Keep all machine tests, rollback protection, and behavior-preservation requirements.

requirements: Owner-fast-lane authorization is recorded in docs/refactoring/owner-fast-lane.json.
A function or aggregate count above its listed ceiling remains a hard failure.
Any unlisted complexity failure remains a hard failure.
A supported reduction makes its ceiling stale and triggers a warning to lower or remove it.
The historical cyclomatic-complexity baseline is not regenerated to absorb this debt.
